comments.value: With moderation action aside from my point made. Its still really annoying when this happens to people and can be taken as a form of online harassment to the player that was kicked from the lobby. And in general it makes it even worse when you have other friends in the instance that are affected.

From my point of view, if you are in someone's world (not public) then the owner should be able to kick people from it (as it currently is) as they pleased since it is their world (instance) so they should have the right to keep who they want in it. If you don't agree with that part ask yourself if you really want to be in that world with that person either way. If not but you want to be with your friends who are in the world then make your own world and invite them (and then you will be the one with permission to kick if needed).

In case you are in a public world, if you haven't done anything bad to be worth a kick usually random (and voted enough) kicks should be rare (compared to if you had done something to deserve it). When that does happen, I think the above way of thinking applies again. If you want to be with those type of people who randomly kick you take the risk of being kicked, if you want to be with a couple who aren't like the others, friend them and do your own world.

This is my solution for you while the current voting system isn't changed (which might not be for a good while, if ever).

Personally I don't have anything against the current voting system so I'm not in favor nor against any of those changes as long as it doesn't affect in a bad way.

@{5b7fff8a70397e19ed0a749b|full_name}: Valid point. I can agree with what you say on this. My only real concern though is that once a user has kicked you from the instance a moderator can see that. It can and has been abused in the past resulting in some of my friends getting really upset over what they thought to have been an instance owned by a friend. (They assumed the room owner was someone else.) And it really sucks that you can't click on a user to see if they own the instance. Perhaps that could be a viable fix for all of this, but either way i will try my best to avoid public instances and ask around who owns the friends plus if i have to from now on.

details: Ive been kicked from several instances by a room owner in a public lobby that i never once talked to, or even for that matter talked to anyone meriting a kick from the lobby. This is not acceptable due to my account getting reported to the moderation team every single time, and i feel like people who do this are just as bad as people who crash said entire lobbies. Here is my fix for all of this. Either we could start designating people by how long they have been playing the game without getting into any trouble as trusted people that can kick from instance if they own the room. Or we could do away with kicking from instances unless you have made the world yourself. Most people that kick others from instances are really just using it due to a distaste for the person they would have rather blocked if they didn't have the option. I should also go on to mention that vote to kick can also be abused heavily but this requires more than one person to achieve and rarely is the case.
title: Stop allowing room owners to kick people malicously from the room.
